manaNeeded: {6}{G}{U}{U} your first turn, with {6}{U}{U} available each other turn
notablePrerequisites: Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.You have no basic lands in library.
description:
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, causing you to mill your library.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat from step 2.
